title: Adventure Realm
description:
Adventure Realm

Adventure Realm is a JRPG Dungeon crawler! Follow the lives of Lusio and his friends as they are mysteriously transported to another Realm! 

There, they must explore their new surroundings and travel to new dungeons to use the power of the gemstones to get back home! 

But the journey won't be easy, as many challenges await our young heroes! 

 

ACT-based combat! 

Experience the Action Time-based combat, choose from a wide variety of skills! With each action having its own variant, you can choose how you do combat! Quickly deal a status effect to an enemy? Or wipe them out with a powerful action! Choose your actions and timing correctly to win any battle![/h4][h4]

Engaging Dungeon crawling!

 In Adventure Realm, Dungeons offer more than just going from A to B. Collect Dungeon Coins by performing various tasks in the Dungeons, collect Dungeon books and Treasure Spheres, spawn Elite Monsters, and defeat them in Combat, all to earn Dungeon Coins for you to spend on Powerful Dungeon Gear! 

QuestThe Village of Everglade will be your main home away from home, and you can interact with all the residents there. Some require your aid but will reward you handsomely.

What dangers and challenges await you in Adventure Realm?
description_short: Experience the JRPG Dungeon Crawler! Join Lusio in exploring a new realm! Fight various monsters, earn dungeon coins, and discover the power of the Gemstones!
